title: Reviewed egress hosts per connection provider (S7 Step 5, P9)
note: The relay's reachability projection (ADR 0009: 'a fixed deterministic projection of OneCLI's observed effective grant set') for app connections, keyed by the same `provider` OneCLI's effective-credentials response names directly. A usable secret instead carries its own reviewed host straight from OneCLI (set when an operator configured it) — no entry needed here. An unknown provider projects to no host: a stale or unreviewed mapping closes access, it never opens it.
